sources.ref: NCERT Class 11 Biology, Ch 9 Biomolecules (2026-27 reprint)

notes: Images generated with Agnes AI through the visual-director presets, reviewed against the checklist and content-qa. Provenance (prompts, hashes, rounds) is in tools/content-research/media/agnes-log.json. Delivered as WebP (3:2 at 1536x1024); originals kept outside the repo.

requests.brief: a stone mortar and pestle with crushed green leaves inside, beside a glass beaker with a piece of white cheesecloth tied over its mouth as a strainer, green liquid collected in the beaker
must_show: mortar and pestle with crushed leaves

alt.en: A stone mortar holding crushed green leaves and a pestle, beside a glass beaker with white cheesecloth tied over its mouth as a strainer and green liquid collected below.
alt.hi: पत्थर की खरल जिसमें कुचली हरी पत्तियाँ और मूसल है, उसके पास एक काँच का बीकर जिसके मुँह पर छलनी की तरह सफ़ेद चीज़क्लॉथ बँधा है और नीचे हरा द्रव इकट्ठा है।

requests.brief: a wooden tray holding fresh turmeric roots, a bundle of lemongrass, a folded sheet of natural rubber and a few amber lumps of plant gum

alt.en: A round tray holding fresh orange turmeric roots, a bundle of lemongrass, a folded sheet of pale natural rubber and a few amber lumps of plant gum.
alt.hi: एक गोल थाली में ताज़ी नारंगी हल्दी की गाँठें, लेमन ग्रास का गुच्छा, प्राकृतिक रबड़ की हल्की रंग की मुड़ी चादर और पादप गोंद की कुछ अंबर रंग की डलियाँ।

requests.brief: two separate straight bead strings lying parallel on a table with a clear gap between them, the strings do not touch or join: the upper string has beads of many different colours and sizes in an irregular order, the lower string has identical round green beads only
must_show: two separate straight strings with a gap

alt.en: Two straight bead strings lying parallel: the upper string has beads of different colours and sizes in an irregular order, and the lower string has identical green beads.
alt.hi: दो सीधी मनकों की लड़ियाँ समानांतर रखी हैं: ऊपर की लड़ी में अलग-अलग रंग और आकार के मनके अनियमित क्रम में हैं, और नीचे की लड़ी में एक जैसे हरे मनके हैं।

requests.brief: one long green cord seen from a three-quarter angle on a table: its left part is wound into a tall upright helix like a stretched telephone cord, and the same cord continues to the right where it is scrunched into a compact, irregular, roundish bundle
must_show: an upright helix on the left
an irregular scrunched bundle on the right

alt.en: One continuous green cord: on the left it is wound into a tall upright coil like a spring, and it runs on to the right where it is scrunched into a loose round bundle.
alt.hi: एक ही लगातार हरी डोरी: बाईं ओर यह स्प्रिंग जैसी ऊँची खड़ी कुंडली में लिपटी है, और आगे दाईं ओर एक ढीले गोल गुच्छे में सिमटी है।

requests.brief: a fluffy open cotton boll on its stem, a small stack of plain white paper and a halved potato on a table

alt.en: An open cotton boll on its stem, a small stack of plain white paper and a halved potato on a green background.
alt.hi: डंठल पर खुला कपास का डोडा, सादे सफ़ेद कागज़ की छोटी गड्डी और आधा कटा आलू, हरी पृष्ठभूमि पर।

requests.brief: on a kitchen counter on a cool winter morning, a clear glass bottle of golden sesame oil that is fully liquid, beside a small steel bowl of fat that has set into a solid pale cream block
must_show: a bottle of liquid golden oil
a bowl of solid set fat

alt.en: A clear glass bottle of golden liquid oil beside a small steel bowl holding a solid pale cream block of fat.
alt.hi: सुनहरे द्रव तेल की एक पारदर्शी काँच की बोतल, और उसके पास स्टील की छोटी कटोरी में वसा का हल्का क्रीम रंग का ठोस टुकड़ा।

requests.brief: a toy train of eight small identical open wagons coupled in a straight line with no engine; each wagon carries exactly one single cube, and the cubes come in four colours (pink, yellow, green, blue) in an irregular order
must_show: exactly one cube in each wagon

alt.en: A toy train of seven small green wagons coupled in a line, each carrying exactly one cube; the cubes are pink, yellow, green and blue.
alt.hi: सात छोटे हरे डिब्बों की एक खिलौना रेलगाड़ी, डिब्बे एक पंक्ति में जुड़े हैं, हर डिब्बे में ठीक एक घन है; घन गुलाबी, पीले, हरे और नीले हैं।

requests.brief: a large rounded soft green shape with one deep pocket cut into its side, and a smaller orange shape that matches the pocket, about to slide into it
must_show: one large shape with a pocket
one small matching shape near the pocket

alt.en: A large rounded green shape with a pocket in its side, and a smaller orange shape fitting into the pocket.
alt.hi: एक बड़ी गोल हरी आकृति जिसके एक ओर जेब है, और एक छोटी नारंगी आकृति जो उस जेब में बैठ रही है।

requests.brief: a small toy car at the foot of a tall green hill; one road climbs high over the hilltop, and a second road goes through a tunnel low in the hill to the same village on the other side, which sits lower than the start
must_show: a high road over the hill
a low tunnel through the hill
the far side lower than the start

alt.en: A tall green hill with a winding road climbing over the top to houses, and a tunnel low in the hill where a small cream car waits at the entrance.
alt.hi: एक ऊँची हरी पहाड़ी, जिस पर घुमावदार सड़क चोटी के घरों तक चढ़ती है, और पहाड़ी में नीचे एक सुरंग जिसके मुहाने पर एक छोटी क्रीम रंग की कार खड़ी है।
